provenance.title: Networking bingo API
provenance.domain: meetup networking bingo game (FARM: FastAPI + ODMantic)
provenance.upstream_tests: none; tests.jac + smoke.py written from the model/route semantics
provenance.trim_note: kept api/ (auth, bingo, utils, main.py, requirements.txt) + LICENSE; frontend/, images/, docker files dropped
provenance.deviations: user lookup spelled as name+discord (upstream's `cls.name == name and cls.discord == discord` reduces to the discord clause; tests only use distinct discord handles); path/body params flattened into walker fields (add_bingo body user_id -> gave_id)

provenance.mapping: ODMantic UserId/UserModel/Attribute/BingoBoard -> nodes on root; 7 handlers -> walker:pub of the same name; result dicts reported verbatim
provenance.reference: hand-written idiomatic Jac port (claude), validated by convert_build
